name: GitHub Pages Landing Page and Public Intake Lane
description: GitHub Pages hosts the static PWA shell serving: the public landing page with demo data, the installable PWA (manifest + service worker), and the public intake lane where visitors submit questions to a hosted queue. The desktop subscribes to that queue. Public users never reach the desktop directly.
purpose: The landing page IS the cockpit at rest. Public mode dogfoods the product — simulated mission timeline, demo receipts, architecture cards, and a codex browser. Clean community intake without exposing the desktop.
acceptanceCriteria: GitHub Pages serves static PWA shell with HTTPS
Public mode renders demo data through same Lit components
Landing page includes simulated mission timeline and demo receipts
Codex browser is read-only public knowledge
Ask a question intake lane submits to hosted queue
Desktop subscribes to intake queue — operator approves/ignores
Approved questions open scoped sessions with status updates via web
Raw shell, filesystem, Valkey, PGlite, and local network never exposed to public
